results.criterion: the per-category retry budget is checked before a strategy is chosen
the strategy chain is followed — the second NO_EFFECT changes strategy
OSCILLATION is not relabelled as a weaker category
STALE_PERCEPTION re-perceives BEFORE acting again
POLICY_BLOCKED gets a budget of one, so a refused proposal is not retried blindly
the explicit transition allowlist is enforced
a category's strategy is remembered, so a chain cannot restart
the record ring is bounded
OSCILLATION outranks a weaker effect-derived category
the APPLICABILITY stage runs after the schema stage
a terminal proposal declaring ACTION must carry an action
ANSWER must carry an answer — a claim with nothing behind it is refused
an unknown proposal kind is refused
a malformed successful response is refused, not defaulted
an inapplicable field is refused rather than stripped
an out-of-range scroll amount is refused rather than clamped
the retry budget is task-class aware — an information task spends less
a rate limit with no Retry-After is never retried
a deterministic failure is not treated as transient
a provider failure is its own truthful terminal state, not a generic failure
the bounded retry budget is applied in the loop
the backend refuses an inapplicable field instead of dropping it
the backend refuses a missing required field instead of inventing one
the backend refuses an out-of-range scroll amount instead of clamping it
